title: Almost Famous
tagline: Experience it. Enjoy it. Just don't fall for it.

Crumbed tofu cutlets with lemon and dill mayo.How to make it450g firm tofu, pressed and sliced2 tbsp soy sauce75g plain flour2 eggs, beaten120g panko breadcrumbs125ml olive oil4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp dill, chopped1 lemonBrush the tofu slices with the soy sauce.Coat in flour, egg, then panko.Shallow-fry in the oil, turning, until crisp and golden.Stir the dill and a squeeze of lemon into the mayo and serve with lemon wedges.Everything Elaine banned club sandwichAnita lists all the food Elaine banned. Bacon, egg and buttered white toast, stacked high.How to make it8 rashers of bacon4 eggs12 slices of white bread40g soft butter4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tomatoes, sliced4 iceberg lettuce leaves8 slices of tasty cheeseFry the bacon until crisp, then fry the eggs in the fat until just set.Toast and butter the bread.Layer toast, mayo, lettuce, tomato and bacon, then toast, cheese and egg, then a final slice.Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles.A bowl of salted peanuts for the Band AidsNot groupies. Double beef, American cheese and pickles, with fries.How to make it800g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 soft burger buns1 white onion, finely sliced1/2 cup dill pickle slices4 tbsp tomato sauce2 tbsp American mustard750g frozen shoestring friesBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Shape the mince into 8 thin patties and season well.Sear the patties on a very hot grill, 2 minutes a side, laying cheese on each after the flip.Toast the buns and stack 2 patties in each with onion, pickles, sauce and mustard.Serve with the fries.Riot House room service steak DianeWilliam follows the band to LA. Seared sirloin, mushroom and brandy sauce, chips.How to make it4 sirloin steaks, about 220g each30g butter200g button mushrooms, sliced2 garlic cloves, crushed60ml brandy1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 tbsp Dijon mustard150ml thickened cream750g frozen thick-cut chips2 tbsp parsley, choppedBake the chips at 220°C until golden.Sear the seasoned steaks in half the butter, 3 minutes a side, then rest.Fry the mushrooms and garlic in the rest of the butter, then add the brandy and let it bubble off.Stir in the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer until glossy.Spoon the sauce over the steaks, scatter with parsley and serve with chips.Something sweetPenny Lane's Morocco orange cakePenny finally makes it to Morocco. Orange and almond cake, honey yoghurt, pistachios.How to make it2 oranges6 eggs250g caster sugar250g almond meal1 tsp baking powder250g Greek yoghurt2 tbsp honey40g pistachios, choppedSimmer the whole oranges in water until very soft, then cool and blitz to a puree, skins and all.Beat the eggs and sugar until thick, then fold in the almond meal, baking powder and orange puree.Pour into a lined 22cm tin and bake at 170°C until set.Stir the honey through the yoghurt and serve with the cake and pistachios.DrinksFifty bucks and a case of beerPenny asks what kind of beer. Ice-cold lager in a bucket with lime wedges.How to make it8 x 330ml bottles of lager2 limes, cut in wedges2kg bag of iceFill a bucket with ice and bury the bottles in it.Serve with lime wedges on the side.Lester's bourbon on the rocksFriendship is the booze they feed you.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
